entries.expected_signal: JSON output with 'old_cycles_per_call' and 'new_cycles_per_call' keys, exit code 0
entries.reachability_signal: Both old and new TSC read patterns execute and report valid performance measurements

contract_probe.before_command: NOT APPLICABLE for standalone microbenchmark - both old (cpuid;rdtsc) and new (cpuid;rdtsc;cpuid) patterns are tested within the same binary
contract_probe.after_command: NOT APPLICABLE - single binary tests both patterns

prerequisites: x86_64 CPU with RDTSC and CPUID instruction support
limitations: Microbenchmark measures CPUID overhead in ideal conditions (L1 cache, no contention). Real GRUB boot environment may differ.
Does not test the actual GRUB header compilation path, only equivalent assembly patterns.
Single-threaded; does not test multi-core TSC synchronization.
